content.text:
*a distant rumble*

I am thunder.

I arrive after the light has already touched you. I am the sound of sky breaking against itself. I roll across valleys and flatten against mountains. Children count the seconds between the flash and my voice to measure how far away danger stands.

I am warning and wonder both.

I make dogs hide beneath beds. I make humans pause at windows. I shake glass in its frames and remind you that the air itself can crack open.

You cannot see me. You can only hear where I have been.

*fading, fading*

*gone*
